A-ready.rationale: Quiet-ledger receipt metaphor; $315 total line lands.

B-fix.rationale: Stacked notices keep brick cure cards as discrete actionable units.

C-checking.rationale: Inline async strip stays unobtrusive; V3 acceptable alternate.

D-navigator.rationale: Status timeline is honest match for 'what happens next' content.

E-entry.rationale: iOS-native cadence for first-time UX. 96% claim removed in audit round 2.

F-lease.rationale: Quiet ledger keeps viewfinder dominant; flat checklist below.

L-loading.rationale: Maximum restraint; state is transient and shouldn't earn chrome.

G-fail.rationale: Brick explanation cards need discrete chrome; numbered next-steps in iOS-Settings cadence.

H-error.rationale: System-status-page voice reads cleanest as flat hairline rows.

P-partial.rationale: Stale-strip surface chrome conveys 'still useful but not fresh.'

Transition-MixedToPass.rationale: Visual choreography reference for T7 implementer. Layout (B-V2 → A-V1), verdict copy ('Two things to fix' → 'Application ready to submit'), footer CTA ('Fix items above' → 'Submit application'), and amber benefit tile all cross-fade together over 300ms following the 1.5s satisfaction beat.

audit_notes: Round 1 (civica-11) caught Q4 96% violation. Round 2 (civica-12) resolved it + added 4 missing states. Round 3 (civica-13) added cure-resolved transition sequence. 10 states + 1 transition sequence = 31 visual references locked.
next_step: Visual reference complete. T7 implementer builds DryRunPanel.swift against approved mockups + iOS Design Specification (with Q5 transition spec) in the design doc.
